**The Lei Orgânica with its history.** The Câmara's SAPL keeps the Lei Orgânica as a structured text with a view of the text in force for each period between amendments, so each amendment is a commit on the day its period starts, credited to the Emenda à Lei Orgânica that gave it.

State law is in [brazil-sao-paulo-law](https://github.com/lexifina/brazil-sao-paulo-law); federal law is in [brazil-law](https://github.com/lexifina/brazil-law).
dates: The first version of the Lei Orgânica is the text SAPL gives in force from 1990-04-05. Each later version is dated by the first day of the period of vigência SAPL gives it and credited to the act SAPL names for it ("Dada por ..."); a period SAPL starts without naming an act is committed as a publisher commit, not guessed. Commits are at noon in São Vicente.
built: Each SAPL view of the Lei Orgânica becomes one file per Art.; each provision is one line, its label followed by its text; headings stand above the first article under them. The notes SAPL keeps under a provision or links into it ("Inclusão feita pelo ..."), provisions it marks as superseded and the amending acts' own blocks it shows inside the text are left out.
limits: The record is SAPL's: a version is only as exact as the Câmara's text for it. Ordinary and complementary laws are not in yet. The text is not the official version: only the Diário Oficial do Município is authoritative.
